test_truncate_monthly: test truncating a datetime series to monthly intervals using dt.truncate with a duration string
test_truncate_date_column: test truncating Date values in a DataFrame using column expressions as the truncation interval
test_truncate_datetime_simple: test truncating datetime series across different time units to month and day boundaries
test_truncate_datetime_expression: test truncating datetime columns using per-row duration expressions from another column
test_truncate_origin_custom: test truncating datetime values with a custom origin multiplier and unit across timezones
